tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag 'jug gsang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru shri he ru ka maṇ+ḍal le bh+yaḥ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag 'jug gsang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan rgyal chen he ru ka'i/ / zhabs kyi pad+mor phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga mdo tsam bri/ /'dir 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi bdag nyid can/ dpal sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i ngag 'don 'khyer bde bar brjod na/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i gnas su dri'i maṇ+ḍal gnas 'dzin gyi tshom bu dang dang bcas pa/ mchod yon chen po sogs mchod pa rnams kyang bshams/ rdor dril nang mchod sogs 'dus byas shrī he ru ko3 haṃ zhes/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo'i dbang phyug tu gyur/ sku'i rnam pa dang nga rgyal brtan po bzung*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs byas/ nang mchod yang gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs/ 'di thog mar byed pa'ang mi 'gal mod/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ thog ma'i gnas yo byin rlabs la/ nang mchod kyis gsang ba'ang nges par dgos pa ma yin pas skabs 'dir byed pa nyid shas che'o/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhi bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ gzhal med khang rim pa bzhi 'khor lo rim pa bcu gnyis/ dbus su sna tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo 'dab ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ phyi nang gi lha'i gdan dang bcas pa skad cig gis grub par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad/ dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par phaiṃ/ oṃ sum+bha= sogs/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ā sa na hūṃ swāhā/ lan gsum sogs brjod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan mang du brjod/ de yang dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba la nyi ma dang*/

dus me/ zhes pa nas/ bzhugs tshul dang*/ phyag rgya ma nges pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar/ lha thams cad kyi zhal phyag rnams gsal gdab/ de nas spro na mchod pa rnams slar yang byin rlabs kha gsos/ mchod 'phreng dang mthun par chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo na bza'/ rig ma bcu drugargyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon sna lnga/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ rkang pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa'i bstod pa tsam byas la/ gtor ma bshams shing byin gyis rlabs/ sgrub thabs ltar 'bul/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra udhi ṣ+ṭha sa nam mkhar btegaslar yang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma bshams shin tu bsdu na/ gnas kyi bdag po la dmigs nas/ /mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bsdus pas kyang rung tsam yin mod kyang*/ nges par na/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor chen mo dang*/ 'byung po spyi gtor chen mo gnyis yod pa gnyis ka'am gang rung cig gal che'o/ /gtor chog rgyas bsdus ci ltar yang*/ 'dod gsol gyi mthar/ gnas kyi bdag po rnams la dmigs te/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ / nod sbyin srin mo'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi/ / dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ / zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab/ gtor ma phyi rol du btang ngo*/ /bar 'dir phur btab sbyin sreg sogs bshad kyang*/ mdor bsdus pa'i skabs mi dgos so/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha la yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ drag tu bzlas shing yungs kar gyis gtor/ sngar gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi shul du sa'i lha mo'i tshom bu dang*/ mchod gtor bshams/ ṭak+ki ni hūṃ dzaḥ oṃ haṃ/ zhes pa nas/ ci bde bar mdzod cig / ces pa'i bar dkyil mchog bde ba chen mo'i char yang bzhin no/ / oṃ pri thi bī de bī bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ sa'i lha mo steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par gyur/ tshom bu dang mchod pa bsdus/ gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ brko sbyangs kyi dus ni 'di yin kyang da lta mi dgos pas/

yung chu shing thal rnams kyis gtor/ ba byung dang*/ dri bzang bsres pas byugs/ oṃ bhuḥlaṃ/ hūṃ laṃ hūṃ/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ri bha ba ban+dha hūṃ/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sho dha ya sho dha ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags tshan rnams ji ltar 'os pa bzlas zhing*/ lag pa sa la regastegs bu dang*/ gter 'jug pa'i dus de 'di yin kyang deng sang mi dgos so/ /de nas lag len 'ga' zhig la/ skabs 'dir sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs byed cing*/ gong du mi byed par de dus gsang chus gtor ba tsam gyis srol yod kyang*/ lag len dkyus ltar la the tshom mi bya'o/ /de ltar na slob dpon bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir 'dug la/ oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ hrī swāhā/ zhes pa nas brtsams te/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzlas pa rdzogs pa yan chad sgrub thabs bzhin du gzhung bsrang bar bya/ de nas mchod yon nyer spyod rol mo dang rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod pa bya/ lce hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ni rdo rje che ge yis/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas la sogs kun 'byon 'tshal/ /dngos grub 'dir ni yang dag stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ bdag ni rang nyid rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang nyid/ / bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /bdag ni stobs chen rdo rje yi/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal/ /phyag na rdo rje brtan pa nga*/ /bdag ni bdag po rdo rje che/ /byin gyis rlabs pa mi 'dor ro/ / zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ 'grub na phyogs bzhi'i gsol 'debs kyang bya/ oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha/ dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg bdag nyid rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi skur gyur/ mig g.yas g.yon ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla bar gyur/ mig 'bras hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/

oṃ kro dha dṛṣ+ti hriḥ oṃ kro dha dṛṣ+ti a/ rkang mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'bar ba re res mtshan par gyur/ hūṃ hūṃ zhes bskor ba gcig sngon du 'gro bas dbang ldan nas/ hūṃ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ / gegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon/ zhes pa nas/ 'dir ni 'jigs 'gyur gzhan du min/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya/ sa gzhi la yungs kar gtor ro/ /'gros dang btang snyoms dgos pa thams cad/ bka' bsgo 'di'i mgo gzhug tu yin mod kyang*/ spros pa la mi mos na/ de dag med kyang cho ga chad pa min no/ / shūn+ya tās stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba/ gur bla re/ mda'i dra ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ra ban+dha hūṃ sogs/ sngags tshun drugasdom pa'i sgrub thabs spyi dang mthun par brjod/ oṃ shū n+ya tā= stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma/ de'i steng du bdag nyid khro bo chen po/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ nag sel ljang ba'i zhal gsum phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgyas 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang*/ zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na thod khrag dang*/ kha ṭaṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang*/ dus mtshan mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ thod skams kyi dbu rgyan/ mi mgo'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ hūṃ gi sgra drag po sgrog cing*/ zhal gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ sma ra smin ma/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi bgegs thams cad 'joms shing za bar byed pa'o/

/ phur bu bcu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ steng dang shar gyi phur bu khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang gi phur bu 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ 'og dang nub kyi phur bu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho'i phur bu phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lho'i phur bu gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub kyi phur bu gshin rje brtan ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang gi phur bu gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar gyi phur bu gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang drag mo chen mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can no/ /rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sum+bha= mang du bzla/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhaṃ= brjod/ oṃ sum+bha sogs tshar gcig sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad spros/ yang sum+bha= tshar gcig phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig pho nya rnams kyi bgegs kha cig ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems la bkod/ nag po'i rigs can kha cig ni bsgral te/ bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing du gnas spar/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu ni bkug ste 'ongs pa phyogs bcur 'khod/ steng gi bgegs rnams khwa gdong ma dang*/ 'og gi bgegs rnams khyi gdong mas tshar bcad hūṃ bcu las byung ba'i khron pa gru gsum zab cing rgya che ba bcu'i nang du bcugayang hūṃ las phur bu bcu spros/ pho nya rnams kyi lag par gtad/ bgegs kyi spyi bor btsugs/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya gha ta ya/ sarba duṣ+tan phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kī ya ya/ badz+ra dha ro a dz+nyā ya ti/ sarba bighā+aun/ kā ya wā kā tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yang hūṃ las tho ba bcu spros/ pho nya rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par gtad/

phur bus spyi bor brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra badz+ra kī la'i a ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thal phyung nas/ de dag gi lus g.yo ba med/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ sems rnam par rtog pa thams cad bcom nas/ 'od gsal gyi ngo bor gyur zhing*/ smon lam gyi stobs las rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas yig brgya mang du bzlas/ smon lam dang*/ bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod de/ sa'i cho ga mdo tsam mo/ /gnyis pa sta gon la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams kyang*/ sgrub thabs bde ba chen po'i char yang nas bshad pa ltar bya/ de nas oṃ hūṃ zhes stan byin gyis rlabs pa nas bzung*/ skye dang skye min spangs pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar du bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon bya ste/ de yang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde ba chen po'i char yang ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de nas lha sta gon ni/ /las thig tu grags pa dkar thig btab/ lha gnas thams cad du tshom bu bkod/ mcho da pa la lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa ni nges par dgos pa yin kyang*/ de sang gi bod pas mi 'byor bas/ ji ltar 'os pa phyogs mtshams rnams su bshams/ 'grub na gtso bo yab yum la tshar mang tsam dang*/ 'khor lo rim pa bcu bdun/ dur khrod rim pa bzhi ste/ nyi shu rtsa gcig la mchod pa tshar re bya/ de nas gtor ma gnyis bshams/ gzhan yang rol mo sogs yo byad rnams tshogs par byas la/ sum+bha= lan mang du brjod pas spyi khyab tu bsangs/ lha gnas kyi grangs dang mnyam par yi ge 'bru gsum brjod/ oṃ na mo shrī badz+ra ḍā ka= zhes pa nas/ hūṃ bcu drug phaṭa swāhā bar du/ yab kyi rtsa sngags lan gsum/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba te nas yo gī shwa ri phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

ces pa'i bar yum gyi rtsa sngags lan gsum/ de nas snying po'i rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad tshan bzhi rnams la/ sarba bud dha 'i sngags re dang*/ gzhan dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams la/ yab kyi nye snying yi ge bdun pa dang*/ yum gyi snying po bai ro tsa na 'i sngags dang*/ skal bzang rnams la'ang yi ge bdun pa tshar re bzla/ de rjes sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba la zla ba dang*/ nyi ma dang dus me'i steng du/ 'jigs byed chen po dang dus kyi mtshan mo'i gdan la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka rdo rje phag mos yang dag par khyud pa'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa grub par gyur/ yang sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs kyi char/ laṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po= zhes pa nas/ skal bzang gi snam bu la zla ba'i gdan rnams so/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog g.yas nagagayon ljang = zhes pa nas/ dbang gi lha rnams rigs bdag la thim zhes pa'i bar du bdag skyed dang 'dra/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs bya ste/ nag po pa'i dkyil chog gi mdun bskyed mchod pa byin rlabs dang 'dra/ de rjes chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga rol mo/ nam bza'/ rig ma bcu drugargyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ bstod pa/ yab yum gyi rkang brgyad/ rkang pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che/ / zhes sogs mtshan brgya rnams bya/ skabs 'dir gtor ma'i cho gas gtor ma 'bul bar bya ste/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa kho na'o/ /de nas bar 'dir bum pa sta gon du gnas pa byed de/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs / stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du a a las zla ba'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi steng du bh+ruṃ bh+ruṃ las/

rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing*/ mgrin pa phra ba mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul bcings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba/ oṃ ta p+te ta p+te/ ma hā ta p+te swāhā/ lan bdun/ lha'i chu bo gang gā bkug par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra shi ṣa re ru ṭa/ ma ṭa sarba di shi hūṃ/ lan gsum gyi kha rgyan du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bdun/ mchod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ dbus kyi bum pa'i nang du/ pad+ma'i lte ba la/ zla ba dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ dus me= zhes pa nas 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ zhes pa nas/ gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /de dag gi bar bar du/ bdud rtsi lngas gang = ces pa nas/ nyer bzhi'o/ / de'i phyi rol du shar nas g.yon bskor gyis= nas sngo nag phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ /de bzhin du/ de'i phyi rol du/ shar nas g.yon skor gyis/ rdo rje 'chang ma mi bskyod ma= nas dmar ser phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ /

des rigs 'gre ste/ de'i phyi rol gyi shar nas g.yon skor du/ bram ze= nas dkar dmar phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ /de'i phyi rol du/ byams pa= nas brtsams te/ glog gi tog gi bar du/ sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ /de'i phyi rol du/ khwa gdong ma= zhes sogs 'don pa spo/ bskyed tshul de kho nas 'og ma rnams la'ang 'don pa spo ste/ de'i phyi rol du shar nas g.yon skor gyi/ mi 'am ci mo= sogs nas/ sku mdog ser po'o/ /de'i phyi rol du mchod pa dang*/ sogs shar du tshangs ma= sogs rigs 'gre/ de bzhin du dkyil 'khor gsum pa la= nas sna tshogs bkra ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol du zla ba'i gdugs= sogs dang*/ shar du gau rī= sogs so/ de bzhin du dkyil 'khor bzhi pa la yang ste/ 'khor lo tha ma'i skabs su/ de'i phyi rol du shar nas g.yon skor gyis nas/ 'khor los bsgyur ma rnams te/ zhes pa nas/ sku mdog dkar po'o/ /de'i phyi rol du 'phags skyes= nas sogs dang / shar du chu skyes dkar mo= sogs 'don pa spos nas/ bzhugs tshul dang*/ phyag rgya ma nges pa'o/ /las bum du/ hūṃ las byung ba'i khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ sku mdog g.yas dmar g.yon ser ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra grol ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ dur khrod kyi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ / 'di ni bum pa gnyis kyi dbang du byas la/ bum pa bcu ltar na/ rnam rgyal bum pa dkyus bzhin/ phyogs mtshams brgyad kyis bum par sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ /las bum du khaṇ+ḍa ro hi bskyed/ shar steng gi mtshan ma hūṃ las he ru ka nag po/ de'i 'og gi mtshan ma maṃ las mkha' 'gro ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo/ byang gi mtshan ma tāṃ las lā ma/ g.yas dmar g.yon ljang*/ nub kyi mtshan mar pāṃ las khaṇ+ḍa ro ha g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ lho'i mtshan ma laṃ las gzugs can ma g.yon ser g.yas sngo ba/

las bum gyi mtshan ma'i gnas su yang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'o/ /lha yab yum thams cad kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ /spyi gtsug tu swāhā hu dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su hūṃ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu ma rta mchog gi ngo bo/ lha mo rnams kyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ oṃsngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyong byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ de nas lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bskul nas/ zhes pa nas/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod pa'i bar bsgrubs thabs bzhin byas nas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sbyar ba lan gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ oṃ sarba bī ra ḍā ki nī ye maṇ+ḍal de ba ta sa pa ri wa re bh+yaḥ a mṛ ta pū tsa pra tī ts+tsha na maḥ lan bcu bdun nam/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ bum pa bcu'i phyogs la/ bkra shis bum pa brgyad la sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags so/ yab kyi rkang pa zhe brgyad pa dang*/ yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan mang du bzla bzhin pas dung chos dang thod pa blangs/ oṃ sarba bī ra ḍā ki ni/ maṇ+ḍal la de ba ta sa pa ri wa ra bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pū dza pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes mchod yon bum par blug rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha rnams rjes su chags pa'i rkyen gyis/ byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du zhu bar gyur/ bum pa bcu yod na/ rnam rgyal bum pa dang*/

bkra shis bum pa brgyad kyi zhes 'jug las bum la ni mchod yon 'bul mod/ lha mi bzhu bar bzhugs pa nyid yin no/ /slar yang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bdun bzlas pas/ me tog dkar po bum par blugade rjes gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ yab yum gyi rtsa sngags tshar re tsam bzla ba'i srol yang la lar 'dug pa ltar yang bya/ de nas gtso bo'i snying po stong dang brgyad/ las bum la khaṇ+ḍa ro ha 'i sngags thung brgya rtsa brgyad/ thun mong du yum gyi snying po brgya rtsa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūṃ/ brgya rtsa bzlas yi ge brgya pa dang bzod gsol byas/ las bum la dmigs te/ ji srid dkyil 'khor byas pa yi/ /bya ba ma rdzogs de srid du/ /bcom ldan 'das ma khyod kyis ni/ /bdag gi gdug pa bskrad par mdzod/ / ces gsol ba gdab bo/ /bar 'dir gtor bsngo'i cho gas dkyus kyi gtor ma de nges par 'bul dgos/ chad du mi rung ngo*/ /'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chog chen mo de/ sta gon gyi skabs kyi cho ga'i yan lag rang du med mi rung min kyang*/ 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi med mi rung min zer ba mthong ngam thos na/ bla chos 'ba' zhig don gnyer gyis tsam me 'jog pa de lta bu ma byed par/ cho ga de dag nges par byed pa gal che'o/ /de nas snyan gsan dbab ste/ lce hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ bcom ldan he ru ka dpal mchog /rig pa'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnas par mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*/ /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang*/ /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/

/gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni che ge rdo rje can/ /che ge 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pa nyer sbyor bas/ /'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bya/ /de phyir bdag dang slob ma la/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer bzung nas/ /dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar 'byon par mdzad pa'i rigs/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ slar yang mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis rlabs/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar/ phyi mchod/ chu gnyis/ nyer spyod/ rig ma bcu drug rnams kyis mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang = sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha zhes dkyil 'khor nam mkhar gteg /slar yang*/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pas bstod/ sum+bha= lan gsum gyis bsrung ba bya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs thams cad/ ji srid spyan ma drangs gyi bar du/ gnas 'di nyid kyi nam mkhar bzhugs la/ sems can thams cad la thugs rjes su brtse ba'i spyan ras kyis bca' ba dang*/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa'i bgegs thams cad zhi zhing*/ slad kyis dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlabs par dgongs pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga ni/ thig skud lnga tshan lnga snod gtsang ma lngar bzhag oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ las shar gyi thig skud dkar po sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka dkar po/ 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mas 'khyud pa/ oṃ āḥswa hūṃ las lho'i thig skud ser po rin chen he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mos 'khyud pa/

oṃ āḥ.aḥ.aḥhūṃ las nub kyi thig skud dmar po pad+ma he ru ka sku mdog dmar po/ pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mos 'khyud pa/ oṃ āḥhā hūṃ las byang gi thig skud ljang khu/ sna tshogs he ru ka sku mdog ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang khus 'khyud pa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ las dbus kyi thig skud nag po/ rdo rje he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mos 'khyud pa/ de ltar na dpa' bo rigs lnga rnams ni/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ thod pa'i 'phreng ba dang*/ phyag rgya drug dang*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs can/ yum lnga po rnams ni/ gri gug dang*/ thod pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing*/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang rigs bdag rang rigs kyis dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa yab yum snyoms par sbyor ba'i sku can/ rnam snang he ru ka zla ba dang*/ gzhan rnams nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'o/ / de nas/ lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ/ sogs gong gi bskyed sngags lnga po de lan bdun sogs ci rigs pa bzlas/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che= sogs kyis bstod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud lnga tshan lngar gyur/ rang gi mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba ser po/ mig 'bras hūṃ gi mtshan pa/ oṃ dīp+ta dṛṣ+ti ang ku sha dzaḥ sta gon gyi lha dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kar ye shes kyi thig skud 'od zer lnga tshan lnga'i rnam pa bzhugs par gyur/ 'khor lo'i thig skud rab tu stsol/ /bdag gi rdo rje'i srad bur shog / lan gsum/ 'bar ba'i lta stangs kyi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus bkug ste/

dam tshig gi thig skud so so la thim/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka dang*/ slob ma rdo rje phag mor gyur/ dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes thig skud brkyang la thig sna gtad/ oṃ a na n+ya a nu ga tā sarba dharmāḥpa ra spa ra a nu pra pṛṣ+ta sarba dharmā at+yan ta/ a nu pra pṛṣ+taḥsarba dharmā hūṃ/ zhes dang*/ yab yum gyi nye snying bzla zhing*/ thig skud bsgril/ thig skud ky-i sne gnyis su hūṃ dang aṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ puṣ+pe= sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma su tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yang mang du brjod/ de nas sa gzhi la/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas te/ ye thig 'debs/ 'grub na gtso bo'i zhal 'jig rten lho la gtod/ ye thig 'debs lugs g.yon skor du byed de/ nag po lugs kyi dkyil chog tu bshad pa ltar ro/ /bsdu na thig skud lha'i ngo bor bsgom pa tsam gyis kyang chog/rgyas par na ye shes spyan 'dren dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab kyang rung ngo*/ /rdul tshon rnams khaṇ+ḍa ro ha sa bsangs ba nas bzung/ dam tshig gi rdul mtshon la thim zhes pa'i bar/ thig skud ces pa rnams rdul mtshon du 'don pa spo/ rdul mtshon mang po gang gis ni/ /sems can sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir/ /sems can rjes su chags pa yi/ /bden 'dis tshon rtsi 'bar bar shog /puṣ+pe= sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ 'di ni chos nyid dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni sgrol byed pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsams/ zhes brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i skor ni/ spyi'i cho gas rigs 'gre'o/ /bzhi pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni mchod pa bshams shing yo byad tshang ba na/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ skyabs sems dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas dang*/

'di nyid kyi gtor ma byin rlabs ltar nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ de nas rtsa sngags tshar gcig brjod/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru kar gyur/ rdul tshon dang*/ dkyil 'khor yo byad dang bcas pa dang*/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la yang dmigs nas sbyang ba dang*/ khrus gsol bya ste/ de yang bgegs gtor bsangs sbyangs nas bzung/ sku phyis 'bul ba'i bar/ nag po lugs kyi dkyil mchog tu bshad pa bzhin bya/ spros pa la mos na/ til sbyang gi rjes su drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyang ba yang byed de/ gzhan du shes so/ / oṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ spangs pa'o zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms/ bzlas pa yang ci rigs bya'o/ /de nas 'di skad ces/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa= sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra nī ta= sogs lan gsum rol mo dang bcas par bya/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la/ mchod pa thams cad kyi mchod par gyur/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rig ma bcu drug dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che= sogs kyis bstod/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ni rdo rje che ge yi/ /'dir ni dkyil 'khor bri ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas la sogs kun 'byon 'tshal/ /dngos grub 'dir ni yang dag stsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis snyan mnan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta pra ṇa me ṇa badz+ra ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ phyag 'tshal/ rang gi thugs ka'i ye shes rdo rje hūṃ yig las/ 'od zer mtha' yas pa spros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs rgyud bskul nas/ thugs ka nas sprul pa'i he ru ka yab yum spyan drangs te rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ yig la thim/

mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor khaṇ+ḍa ro ha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ sta gon du gnas pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen po yang bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi nam mkha'i phyogs nye ba na bzhugs par gyur/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor= zhes pa nas/ zla ba'i gdan rnams so/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad mnyes par byas/ sems can gyi khams thams cad sbyangs/ 'khor lo bcu gsum gyis lha tshogs rnams kyi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa grub pa dang*/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mchog tu gsal zhing 'bar bar bzhugs pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka= zhes pa nas/ phyag rgya ma nges pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin 'don/

rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ yig las 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha ye shes dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ nyi shu rtsa bdun sogs mang du brjod/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha= gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ ljang sngon= nas phyi rol thams cad gang bar gyur/ gyi bar go cha dgod/ hūṃ zhes lan gsum brjod dkyil 'khor pa thams cad gtso bo'i ye shes gcig gi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor chen po'i nang du rang nyid zhugs par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi 'gro ltar byas nas/ chu gnyis nyer spyod/ rol mo/ rig ma bcu drug rnams sngags tsam gyis phul/ rkang pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pas bstod/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas me tog bzung la/ hūṃ zhes brjod/ bdag nyid he ru ka rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ ma hā ra ta su ḍi ta/ su to ṣ+ya/ su su kho/ badz+ra satwa/ ad+ya sid+dh+ya maṃ/ zhais pa lan gsum gyis/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du bskor ba byas par gyur/ go skabs yangs na dngos su yang skor ba bya'o/ / ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ slar yang dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ oṃ pra tits+tsha badz+ra hoḥ.oṃ pra ti grih+ṇe s+t+waṃ/ i maṃ sa twa mahā ba la/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i drung du gnas nas/ khro bo'i lta stangs dang bcas pas sgo phye/ oṃ badz+ra uta gha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bzhi bdud rtsi lnga dang dri chab sbyar bas bkang ba'i dung phor ram thod pa dkyil 'khor gyi drung du bzhag oṃ badz+ra a mṛ te a mṛ taṃ pra be shā ya hūṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra gā mi ni/ sarba bha k+ṣaṃ sho dha ya gu h+ya badz+ri ṇi swāhā/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la sngags kyi dngos grub dam pa'i bka'i gnang ba stsal du gsol/

lan gsum de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ / mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /de nyid shes nas de nas ni/ /dpa' bos 'dod pa lnga spyad do/ /bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyi dngos/ /bdag nyid lha mo kun gyi gnas/ /de phyir bdag gis thams cad bya/ /bdag nyid he ru ka dpal mchod/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung chos can/ /sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no/ /khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /'gro ba'i don ni mnyam med byos/ /zhes bka'i gnang ba stsal bar gyur/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes lan gsum/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ yig las 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal he ru ka 'khor lo sdom pa/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor chen po ye shes kyi 'khor lo la phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pas bskor ba pheṃ/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon sum mdzad/ /mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa/ /rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te/ /sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig /sum+bha= sogs kyis bsangs/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po lan mang du brjod/ ye shes 'khor lo mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor chen po'i steng gi nam mkha' la rab tu dges pas bzhugs par gyur/ mchod yon dang*/ nyer spyod tsam sngags kyis phul la/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che= zhes sogs mtshan brgyas bstod/ rol mo'i sgra sgrags/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ lan nyer bdun tsam dang*/ yo ga shud+dho= lan gsum/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ro gcig tu gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ dbang gi lha= zhes pa nas/ dbang gi lha rnams rigs bdag la thim/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin no/ / gang 'dir rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ni phyag rgya chen po'o/

/rjes chags kyi bde bas gang ba ni/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ yig ni stong nyid snying rjer gnas pa ste chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /thugs rje chen po bskyed de sprul pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni las kyi phyag rgya'o/ / zhes brjod cing don bsam la/ slar yang 'di skad ces/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /rang rang kha dog phyag mtshan 'chang*/ /sprul pa'i sku yi gzugs kyis ni/ /phyag rgya chen por rab tu grags/ /dpa' bo gnyis kyi snyoms 'jug pa/ /bsgoms pa'i bdag nyid de don du/ /shes rab mi mo'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /de ni dam tshig tu ni brjod/ / byang chub sa bon skyed byed gang*/ /zhing du byed pa'i bdag nyid de/ /yang dag mthar ni rnam dag pas/ /chos kyi phyag rgya zhes brjod do/ /sems can phung po ma lus pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob byed du/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i lte ba yis/ /las kyi phyag rgya zhes grags so/ /'on kyang de bzhin lha mo rnams/ /dga' rol dam tshig tu ni dran/ /rang gi 'bad rtsol skad cig pa/ /las kyi phyag rgyar de bzhin 'gyur/ / zhes brjod cing mnyam par bzhag go bar 'dir mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa ji ltar 'os pa bya ste/ gtso bo yab yum gyi rtsa sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzla/ de tsam mi nus na/ rtsa sngags gnyis tshar gcig gam gsum gang rigs brjod nas/ snying po brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi mtshan sngags bzla bar 'dod na'ang*/ tshar gcig tsam 'don par zad da ེ/ 'on kyang spros par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor du bum pa 'god de/ rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i mdun thad gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i shar sgo dang nye bar bzhagagatso bo yab yum gyi snying po ci rigs pa bzlos/ de'i byang du las bum kyang bzhag ste/ ṣaṇ+ḍa ro ha cung zad bzlas so/ /drug gi phyogs la'ang gnyis po de dang 'dra/ gzhan bzhi mtshams bzhir bzhag go

/bcu'i phyogs la'ang gnyis po 'dra/ bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad ni/ sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhi'i thad kyi phyi rol du dgod/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa dngos ni/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs spyi 'gro ltar byas pa'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan mang du bzla zhing*/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū= sogs dang*/ oṃ puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ dhu paṃ dī paṃ gan+dhaṃ nai bi t+yaṃ bh+ri k+ṣaṃ rnams la'ang sbyar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ha s+ya= la s+ya= ra ti= puṣ+ta= sa hū sh+ya ya= a nut+ta ra/ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa hūṃ/ zhes dang*/ oṃ a nut+ta ra/ sarba pū dza me gha sa mud ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags lan gsum gsum mo/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul ba dngos ni/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i= zhes pa nas/ spar+sha kā ma gu ṇa 'i bar du nag po lugs kyi dkyil chog bzhin du phul/ lha mo bcu drug la tshigs bcad gzhan mang po yod pa'ang byas na legs par 'ong*/ nang mchod bla ma rgyud pa'i skabs/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyag na rdo rje dang*/ /rnal 'byor ma dpal spyan ras gzigs dbang dang*/ /blo gros rin chen shā bā ri pa la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa 'bul/ /mai tri gu pa rgya gar phyag na dang*/ /ka ma la pa dza ya s+ya na dang*/ /sum pa lo tsā rje btsun grags rgyal la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi mchog gi= sa skya paṇa chen rin chen skyob pa dpal/ /rgyal tsha chos dbang mang mkhar lo tsa ba/ /blo chen pa dang bla ma ye shes dpal/ /dar ma bzang po grags chen spang khang pa/ /slob dpon rin brtson mkhan chen byang seng pa/ /theg chen chos rje brag thog bsod bzang la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi= kun dga' rnam rgyal rgya ston byang dbang dang*/ /grol mchog zhabs dang mkhas mchog byams pa'i mtshan/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ ye shes bdud rtsi= yang na rang cag chos nan tan bya ba'i 'os su bgrang ba ni/

sum pa lo tsā mkhas pa sa mu dra/ /seng ge rgyal mtshan yang klungs lo tsā ba/ /rong pa sher seng kyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags/ /kun mkhyen chen po dus gsum sangs rgyas dang*/ /slob dpon chos grags mkhan chen byang seng ba/ / de man chad sngar bzhin byas na/ brgyud pa shin tu bzang ba la/ rong pa sher seng yan chad kyi brgyud rim shin tu rnyed dka' bar gyur pa yun ring lon pa las/ phyis mkhan chen grub pa shes rab kyi gsan yig las rnyed pa'o/ /rgyud pa'i rnam grangs mi 'dra ba rnams gzhan du bshad zin to/ /shin tu nye brgyud ni/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje phag mo dang*/ /shā bā ri dbang rje btsun grol mchog dang*/ /gdod ma'i mgon po lha dbang grags pa la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ /gzhan yang rtsa ba'i bla ma/ brgyud pa'i bla ma= zhes pa nas/ a nu rā ga ṇa'i bar 'dra ba las/ 'khor tshogs kyi skabs rnams mi dgos/ ci ste shin tu spros pa la dga' na/ dus 'khor gyi arka chen mo bzhin byas na 'ong*/ de rjes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas rkang pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa dang*/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che= sogs mtshan brgya dang*/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba 'jigs pa'i gzugs ldan pa/ sogs mtshan brgya gnyis pas kyang bstod/ bar 'dir kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i bstod chen kyang 'don/ de rjes/ khrus kyi rdzing bu dam pa dang*/ zhes pa nas gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ zhes pa'i bar yang*/ nag po dkyil chog gi mchod 'phreng bzhin no/ /bar 'dir phyi rol gtor ma gtong ste/ rgyas par na 'byung po thams cad pa dang*/ zhing skyong gi gtor ma gnyis kar byed/ 'bring du gang rung cig bya/ bsdus par na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dkyus nyid yin pa las/ dṛ sh+ya ho zhes pa'i rjes su/ gang du bcom ldan 'das lhan cig /'ongs pa'i phyogs kyi bdag po rnams/

/gang yang rjes su 'brang zhes 'dir/ /gnas pa de dag thams cad rnams/ /bdag ni rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /ji ltar yod pa'i dri dang ni/ /me tog sogs dang gtor ma yang*/ /so sor bzhes te sems can la/ /byams pa'i sems dang slob ma la/ /gegs med par ni mdzad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis mchod yon phul/ puṣ+pe= la sogs pa nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ kha kha= man chad du spyi dang 'dra/ mchod pa bsdu ba/ mchod yon bsgreng ba/ mtshams bcad pa sogs kyang phyi rol gtor ma spyi 'gro'i rim pas choga'on kyang 'dir skor ba sgo dbye/ me tog 'bul ba rnams ni mi dgos te/ sngar zin pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /ci ste spros pa la dga' ba dang*/ ga khyer 'dod pas byed snyam na mdzod cig /de la bdag gis ci zhig bya/ de nas bdag 'jug gi don du khrus byas te/ 'jug pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ rdo rje phag mo rab sbyor ba/ /bdag gi ston pa dga' chen khyod/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa/ / zhais pa nas/ gzhug tu gsol/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi hūṃ/ bdag nyid gtso bo he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi a lang ka ra bas+t+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsak+ṣur ban+dha ba ra ma ṇa ya hūṃ/ ā haṃ bhī ra hūṃ/ oṃ dngos grub kun gyi grong khyer nyams dga' ba/ /thar pa'i grong du dpal ldan bde chen 'jug /mchog gi bde ba dam pa'i dngos grub kyi/ / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrab tu grub par mdzod/ /bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du yongs su zhugs par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pas+tha nā ya/ asma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha maṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bud+dha pū dza u pas+tha nā ya/ at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bai ro tsa na a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa ma/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ṇe/ at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru maṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta na ya/ at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma pra brta ya mi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya/ at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes phyogs bzhi phyag 'tshal bya/ dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol/ /rdo rje'i rigs kun bsdus pa la/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'jug mdzod/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /skal ba chen po bdag la stsol/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis rgyas btab cing*/ /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ba/ / mgon po chen po bdag la stsol/ /dbang bskur pa ni rmad byung che/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ / zhes lan gsum/ 'di dza ya s+ya na'i lugs so/ /tshig 'dis gsol ba 'debs phyin dum bu la bcos ka byed pa bas/ gtso bo bdag la sdom pa stsol/ / zhes sogs rgyud nas 'byung ba de rdzogs par byas na ka legs so/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /byang chub sems ni yongs bzung la/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug cing*/ /dam tshig sdom pa nong par mdzod/ /lan gsum/ gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /bdag 'dod do zhes de la 'don pa spo/ de ltar na gsol gdab dang 'di dag kyang*/ dkyil chog gnyis kyi lugs 'di yang 'gal ba cher med dam snyam nas bkod pa yin/ spyir ni rgyud gzhung tshad ldan ltar byas na ka brling ngo*/ /de nas sdom pa sgrag ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong*/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/

/slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes sgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bya/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni/ /phas phaṃ par ni rab tu bshad/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bslab par bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /'dod la log par mi spyad cing*/ /rdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi/ /chang ni rnam par spangs bar bya/ /sems can don phyir ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spangs/ /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing*/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang*/ /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang*/ /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus pa ni rjes su srung*/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spang*/ /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ / lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*/ /mtshan ma 'god par mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni/
/ gsang ba'i rgyud las yang dag bshad/ /

ces dam tshig sgrags/ slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar du ni bdag gis bgyi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams nas mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa byang chub kyi sems kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis su med pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yo ga tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta yo gi kā ya wāka tsit+ta u ta pa ya mi/ a she sha a na ba she ṣa/ satwa dha tu hi ta/ su khot+ta ma sid+dhi ā d+yan ta bha wa sid+dha ma he shwar+ya dhi pa t+ya tsa ya/ zhes sems bskyed pa la ched du brjod pa byas/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes me tog slar yang bzung*/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub che/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams ni gzhug par bya/ / zhes dkyil 'khor la gsol ba btab/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ zhes yol ba bsal/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ khyod kyis 'di dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di'o/ /gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la/ /'di smras na ni mgo bo 'gems/ /oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang*/ khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /hūṃ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub n-i/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis thob/ /oṃ pañca a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hūṃ/

deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi dpal phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig /byas na yang de ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur ta re/ de dag ni dam la bzhag pa'o/ /ye shes dbab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ rang he ru ka phyag gnyis pa zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs byas bzhugs par gyur/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte ba la/ rtsa a wa dhutī chu shing gi me tog lta bu'i nang na/ dpyid dang thig le kha sbyor bar gnas pa ni/ dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mos 'khyud pa/ bde ba chen po rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/ phyogs bzhir lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ yum bzhi/ mtshams bzhir oṃ yig bzhi thod pa bzhi'i ngo bo/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ pu dzaḥ nas ma bu khams rnams dpa' bo dang rtsa rnams dpa' mo/ bu ga brgyad la hūṃ ring po brgyad sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi ngo bo/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dpal he ru ka rig ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ lus kyi stod kyi cha la thugs rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha tshogs rnams kha dog nag po'i rnam pas thim/ bar gyi cha la gsung rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha tshogs rnams dmar po'i rnam pas thim/ smad kyi cha la sku rdo rje'i rigs rnams dkar po'i rnam pas 'jug cing*/ gtso bo rig mar bcas pa dang*/ de ma yin pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa yang*/

ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs te snying gar thim pa'i rkyen gyis snying ga'i dpa' bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ sbyor mtshams nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer 'phros pas/ lus thams cad bde ba chen pos gang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las lha tshogs dpag tu med pa char babs pa bzhin tu byung ste/ snying gar thim/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha a be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes rol mo'i sgra bya/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hri da ya me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ sarba sid+dhiṃ me/ pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaṃ/ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ zhes pa'i brtan par bya'o/ / dkyil chog gi gzhung gnyis las ni/ me tog mgo la bcings nas mig 'byed pa'i bar la/ bden stobs gnyis pa brjod pa dang*/ mig phye nas blta bar bskul ba'i bar la nam mkha'i kha dog dri ba byas pa ni/ su dang yang mi mthun pa'i lag len ar kha mar 'dug cing*/ skye bo mang po la dbang phyogs gcig tu bskur na/ shin tu byed stabs mi bde'o/ /des na/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / zhes pa nas/ kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog / ces bden stobs dang po de brjod nas/ rang gi las dang rjes su mthun pa'i nam mkha'i kha dog mthong bar gyur/ yang dag pa dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ /bsod nams ci 'dra de 'drar shog /de yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig / ces bden stobs gnyis pa brjod/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ/ be sha ku laṃ shi ṣ+ya mahā ba la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hūṃ a/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/

/da ni dad pa rab tu skye/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*/ /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*/ /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi dus yin na dkyil 'khor mtha' dag rgyas par bstan no/ /bdag 'jug la yang de bzhin byas na bzang mod kyi/ byed pa'i srol med do/ / oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong*/ / gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ / sa ma ya ho ho ho/ / zhes ched du brjod do/ /de nas 'khor lo'i lha'i dag pa bshad pa ni/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa/ /dpal ni he ru ka zhes bya/ /rdo rje ye shes dbyer med phyir/ /rtag tu sgrib pa las sgrib dang*/ /'dod chags dman pa'i sbyor ba gang*/ /rdo rje sngon song can phag mo/ /mchog tu 'gro ba'i ngang tshul ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ de'i rigs lnga/ rtag tu bdug pa za bas lā ma dang*/ de'i rigs lnga/ dum bur byed cing skyed pas dum skyes ma dang*/ de'i rigs lnga/ sna tshogs pa'i gzugs 'dzin pas gzugs can ma dang de'i rigs lnga/ gtso bos ni/ rgyud rnams dag pas phyag bdun cu don gnyis/ rgod pa sogs dag pas phyag dang po bzhi/ dga' ba bcu drug ye shes dang bcas pa ni zhal bcu bdun/ 'khor 'das mnan pas zhabs gnyis sam/ stong nyid bco brgyad dag pas zhabs bco brgyad/ gnas bcu gnyis dang*/ sa bcu gnyis dag pas 'khor lo bcu gnyis/

ye shes dang chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa kun nas mnyam pas pho brang nang ma gsum po zlum po/ mtha' bzhi spyod cing sprul pa kun tu rgyas pas phyi ma gru bzhi pa/ rlung gnyis dbu mar 'dus pa dang*/ sku gsum dang dga' bzhi dang ye shes lnga dag pas/ de dag gi rtsig pa'i rim pa'o/ /bzhi pa kun gyi thun mong du/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i thig yin phyir/ /mnyam pa tshad med la sogs so/ /tshul khrims sdom pa bla med pa/ /rgyan gang yin par yang dag bshad/ /dad pa'i dbang po sogs can sems/ /rtsig pa lnga ru 'byung ba yin/ /rnam par thar pa rnam pa bzhi/ /gang zhig sgor ni yang dag bshad/ /yang dag rab tu spong ba bzhi/ /rta babs kyi ni ka bar 'byung*/ /dran pa'i ye shes bzhi rnams ni/ kha khyor bzhi ru dran par bya/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi ni rkang pa bzhi/ /sgo 'khyud rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /byang chub yan lag bdun 'phreng ba/ /ba dan me tog 'phreng bar brjod/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes ni/ /ting 'dzin gnyis su btags pa yin/ /lam gyi ye shes khyad par ni/ /rnga yab tu ni brjod pa'o/ /nyon mongs thams cad zad byed pas/ /de bzhin dra ba zhes brjod do/ /yang dag gcod pa'i rab 'phrog dang*/ /rnam par sel ba'i rab 'phrog pas/ /tshogs gnyis kyi ni sbyor ba ste/ /nyon mongs rnams kyi phyed 'phrog phyir/ /dra ba phyed pa zhes brjod do/ /'phags pa'i lam ni ka ba brgyad/ /de yi dbus kyi pad+ma gang*/ /skyon gyis ma gos par bston no/ /'khor lo bcu gnyis bshad pa rnams/ /sa yi mi mthun phyogs spang ba/ /yang dag bshad pa'i rtsibs 'di rnams/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs sel/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba la sogs gang*/ /glo bur ba yi dri ma sel/ /cha shas bcu drug rnams kyi bar/ /dur khrod dag par shes par bya/ /mdor na yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi rnam par rol ba mtha' dag rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du shar ba'o/

/ de dag gi 'jug pa'i cho ga bshad zin to/ /de nas rdo rje'i slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ / byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal pa ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du/ shar phyogs kyi lha snam la dbang stegs kyi gdan la rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas gnas par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas phyag gnyis pa zhig chad/ sbyang ba'i las mdzad par gyur/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya badz+ra sas+t+wa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha na swāhā/ oṃ hūṃ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ sarba ma la a ba ra ṇa bi ṣo dha ni swāhā/ oṃ pun+ya dz+nyā na dha ra sam+bha raṇ+ḍo pa kā ya swāhā/ oṃ bha ra bha ra sam+bha ra sam+bha ra swāhā/ bden pa bdar ba'i mthar/ bdag cag rnams kyi phung po drug khams drug dbang po drug la sogs pa la gnas te/ dbang gi ye shes skye ba la bar du gcod cing*/ mi mthun par gyur pa byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang*/ bkra mi shis par 'gyur ba/ bgegs dang log 'dren gnod byed thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig ces rol mo'i sgra sgrogs so/ / oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pro k+ṣa ma ṇaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra an+tsa ma naṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ swāhā/ puṣ+pe= ā lo ke= hūṃ lan bdun brjod/ bdag cag rnams kyi byur dang*/ skal ba ngan pa dang*/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad shān ting ku ru swāhā/ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha ིsa bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro he ru ka sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/

ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ spyan gsum po khro zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rnam par phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus la phog pas 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ gzhir gnas kyi byang chub sems dang 'dres/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkha' nang du babs/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro= nas thugs kar hūṃ gi= bar rnam rgyal bum pa'i skabs bzhin/ yang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas par nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ rig pa'i lha mo sras dang bcas pa thams cad nam mkha'i dbyings su badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs nyer spyod lnga/ shap+ta dang bcas pas phul/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*/ /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de bzhin 'di la gnang ba mdzod/ / ces gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i dbu gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi chu skyes dbus su byon pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis rang nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi skur gsal ba la dbang bskur zhing*/

dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te dag pa'i shel ltar gyur/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rdul phra rab las/ de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' yab yum/ khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang gi lha tshogs mtha' yas par sprul te/ gsang ba'i chu skyes las phyi rol du byon/ mkha' dbyings thams cad gang bar bzhugs te/ hūṃ zhes bya bas rang nyid 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma'i gsang ba'i mtha' nas phyir spros te/ dbang stegs kyi steng du 'khod par gyur/ de'i tshe rdo rje phag mo dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rig ma rnams kyis/ bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar 'dzin zhing*/ yal 'dab kyis 'thor ba dang*/ phyogs thams cad nas sna tshogs pa'i mchod pas bstibs shing*/ gur gum dang me tog la sogs pa'i char phab/ rnga bo che'i sgra sgrags/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis shis pa brjod par gyur/ oṃ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /

de nas spro na/ bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag rdo rje'i rigs dang ldan/ / zhes sogs bya zhing*/ bsdu na/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis tsam brjod/ dung chos sam rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu thogs te/ oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣe ka na twa a bhi ṣiñca mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa dhi twe na ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ zhes pa'i mthar/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum byung ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sbyin par bya/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes gsungs zhing*/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ chu dbang ngo*/ /oṃ swa bhā wa bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las/ aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rin chen he ru ka sku mdog ser po/ g.yas rin po che dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ thod pa'i 'phreng ba dang*/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ spyan gsum pa/ khro zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/ yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rnam par phaiṃ/

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan gnyis/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan zhu ba las/ dbus su me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs kyi lha'am/ dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa mtha' bskor du rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku gzugs kyis mtshan pa'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dhā twi shwa rī a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta satwa badz+ri ṇi a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñca hrī/ oṃ karma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes rang rang gi phyag rgya gnas lngar gtugs pa'am/ bsdu na dbu rgyan byin gyis rlobs pa'i sngags su byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas dbang bskur rdo rje chen po= sogs/ mthar/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ oṃ hūṃ hraṃ hriḥ.aḥ dar dpyangs bcings/ oṃ badz+ra u ta ka a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ las kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nyes skyon thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= sogs/ de ltar na cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ /cod pan gyi dbang des rigs bsgres te/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka mi= dz+riṃ las pad dz+ri gis= pad+ma mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar po g.yas pad+ma= yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ thams cad pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma yab yum gyi rnam par= pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum zhu ba las/ dbang rdzas rdo rje= dbang bskur rdo rje chen po= sogs kyi rjes la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis rdo rje yi/ /dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur/ /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje rab tu grub phyir bzung*/

/oṃ āḥm hā badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra u ta ka= sogs/ spyi bor 'khyil ba las 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= de ltar na rdo rje= 'dod chags= 'du shes kyi= so sor rtog pa'i= 'od dpag med kyi= zhes 'don pa spo/ rdo rje'i dbang ngo*/ / de bzhin du/ bdag dbang rdzas dril bu= khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis= sna tshogs mkha' 'gro sku mdog ljang khu= g.yas ral gri= yum sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma yang sku mdog ljang khu= thams cad sna tshogs mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rnam par= dbang rdzas kyi sna tshogs mkha' 'gro= dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ dbang bskur rdo rje= sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dril bu gtad/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe a a/ bcom ldan bzung ngo bdag la ni/ /yang dag nye bar gyur par mdzod/ badz+ra u ta ka 'khyil ba las don yod grub pas/ badz+ra puṣ+pe= dril bu'i dbang = phrag dog= 'du byed kyi= bya ba sgrub pa'i= don yod grub pa'i= dril bu'i dbang ngo*/ /bdag dang dbang rdzas dril bu gnyis ka= pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa= sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro= sku mdog dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo= thams cad sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rnam par= dbang rdzas kyi sangs rgyas kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dril bur gyur/ dbang bskur rdo rje/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ badz+ra na maḥ.a bhi ṣe ka ta/ dpal rdo rje he ru ka khyod yin no/ /badz+ra u da ka= rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan/ badz+ra puṣ+pe= ming gi dbang = gti mug= gzugs kyi phung po= chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes= rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang = de ltar rig pa'i dbang lnga po 'di dag la/ spros pa la dga' na/ re re bzhin du mgor byang chub rdo rje sogs kyi gsol btab dang*/

dbang lha spyan drangs/ mchod bstod gsol ba btab/ chu dbang gi skabs bzhin dbang rdzas sngon la lhar bskyed de/ ye shes pa bstim/ bar der dbang rdzas la mchod bstod/ rigs lnga so so'i sngags lan bdun nam/ nyer gcig tsam bzla/ de rjes slob ma sngon bzhin nang chog gis bskyed/ mchod cing gsol ba btab/ nang dbang bskur nas phyir spros/ dbang stegs kyi steng du bkod pa la/ re re bzhin shis brjod byed de/ rigs lnga'i bkra shis so sor bkram/ gzhan kha 'gengs ji ltar 'os pa bya/ slob ma'i kyang*/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ de nas dbang dngos gzhi so sor bskur/ rigs bdag gis dbu rgyan pa'i rjes su/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du bstim/ de nas mchod pa dang dag dran bya/ dbang lha dang*/ dbang rdzas dang*/ slob ma mchod pa la mchod yon dang*/ rol mo byed mi byed kyi khyad dang*/ dbang rdzas dang slob ma la bstod pa byed pa'ang yod de/ cho ga spros pa la mos na/ de ltar byas pas/ lhag pa'i skyon med cing gzhung don dang mthun pas legs par 'gyur gyi/ thob thang med pa'i bskyed chog dang*/ lhad kyi tshig mang po 'jug pa sogs ni mi bya'o/ /rig dbang 'di rnams dbang thams cad kyi gzhi rten du 'dug pas/ spros pa cung zad skyed kyang mi legs pa ni ma yin no/ /slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gis bdag gi khyod drin las/ /rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*/ /thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol/ /dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khrus kyi khang pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ rang nyid dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po he ru ka phyag g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas thugs kar bsnol ba/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang*/ thod pa'i 'phreng ba dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/

stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing spyan gsum pa/ khro zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'i skur gyur/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūṃ/ rgyas pa la dga' bas/ 'di nang chog gis bskyed kyang rung ngo*/ /yang na bsgom bya'i lha dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum gnyis du bskyed na'ang shin tu legs so/ /de nas bum pa'i thod pa thogs te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po= sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ rtsa sngags gnyis kyi mthar/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ bsdu na yab yum gyi snying pos byas rung tsam yin/ he ru ka rigs lngas rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'i con pan gyis dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra dhā twi shwa ri= zhes pa nas/ a bhi ṣiñca aḥ oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ku ṭa= nas/ hriḥ.āḥ khro bo'i rdo rje gtad la/ rtag tu 'dod chags las byung khro/ /rdo rje me yi phung po'i sku/ /'bar ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor che/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun 'bar ba'o/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /hrīḥlas byung ba'i dril bu bcom ldan 'das ma'i ngo bo gtad de/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ= sogs dang*/ hrīḥthams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam sbyor ba yi/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis bdag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ / rang bzhin dag pas sems dpa' mchog /dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur/ / dbang bskur rdo rje sogs kyi mthar / kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /rig ma rdo rje phag mo'am/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa/ sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/

bzhad pa dang*/ 'khyud pa'i bde ba sku nyams su bstar/ shin tu bla bas bde 'gyur dang*/ /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyis long*/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ci 'dod par ni brtan bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bar/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig zhes su brjod/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /mkhas mchog bzhugs par gyur gyi bar/ /de srid mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu sgrags/ / de nas brtan byed du bum pa'i chus dbang bskur dgos te/ dbang bskur rdo rje= nas yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu rgyan/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes kyi lha dpal he ru ka /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs shing*/ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i dbang gi lha rnams dang lhan cig rang la thim/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ar+ghaṃ/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rol mo dang bcas te/ bstod pa ji ltar 'os pas bstod/ slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed pa yin na rkang brgyad dang*/ rdo rje 'chang du bsgom pa yin na de nyid lnga pas bstod zer ro/ / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ brtan bzhugs bya/ de nas brtsams te rnal 'byor pas/ /rgyud kun las ni gsungs pa yi/ /ma lus lus pa med 'gyur ba'i/ /cho ga yis ni dkyil 'khor bris/ /ji ltar rnam par 'dod pa yis/ /rang 'dod lha yi 'jug pa nyid/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dngos grub gang*/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma

ni/ /ji ltar dmigs pa'i yid kyis su/ /ji ltar nus pa gzhan du sgrub/ /phran tshegs la sogs pa yi las/ /de yis dngos grub sgrub pa la/ /rang dang gzhan la grags pa yi/ /de 'grub pa la the tshom med/ / ces brjod de/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga'o/ /skabs 'dir rjes gnang la sogs pa'i mtha' rten rnams byas kyang legs so/ / de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis srungs/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa yin no/ /gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /bdag gis bla med byang chub thob/ /de phyir gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /mgon pos bdag la thugs brtser mdzod/ / lan gsum/ 'bru gsum gyis mig dar bcings/ rdo rje slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'khor lo'i dbang phyug dpal he ru ka dbyer ma mchis pa nyid/ rig ma rigs thams cad kyi 'khor lo'i bdag mo/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mos yang dag par 'khyud pa'i sku can du gyur/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa na bzhugs pa'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa thams cad kyang*/ thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis rjes chags byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug yab yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ gzhir gnas kyi byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhir dga' bzhi'i ye shes brtan par byas/ rdo rje nor bu dang*/

nā ra nā si kar/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ring du sku nyams su bstar ba'i rten byang chub kyi sems yang dag par blang ste lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs kyi mthar/ / ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /'di ste dpa' bo lha mo rnams/ /dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ khams lnga ldan pa'i ror rtogs byed/ /bde ba gang de myong bar byos/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdag 'jug gi skabs su de tsam gyis chog la/ rgyal bde'i dkyil chog nas/ byang chub kyi sems/ bsgrubs zin nas slob pa la sbyin pa'i bar du/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ zhes sogs shis brjod byed gsungs te/ shis brjod de ltar byed na lugs gsum yod de/ gsang dbang gi mig dar bcings ma thag tu/ dbang lha spyan drangs shis brjod byed/ spro na chu dbang bskur ba ni lugs gcig dang*/ gsang dbang dngos bskur grub mtshams su shis brjod sngon du 'gro bas/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ bum chu bsres te dbang bskur ba ni lugs gnyis pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i shis brjod sngon du song nas/ chags la 'dod chags bdag nyid sbyor/ /zhes sogs ched du brjod pa dang lhan cig zhu bar byed pa ni gsum pa yin no/ /'di gsum gang dang yang mi mthun par/ byang chub kyi sems sgrubs zin pa'i rjes la byed pa tsam la ni/ khungs med cing rig pas kyang mi 'thad pa'o/ /

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mig dar bsal/ gang de dga' ba'i rang bzhin snying la bde byed de yang btags pa tsam/ /gang yang chags bral yang ni rgyu'am gnyis ka srid pa'i rtse mo'i rgyu/ /ji srid rgya la yid kyi rnam par rtog pa 'phro ba spangs pa'i gzugs/ /de srid mya ngan 'das pa gzhan la yod min yul ni rtogs pa'i bdag /'di ni de nyid mi shes pa'i/ /slob ma rnams la bshad mi bya/ /blo ldan rtog pa med pa la/ /shin tu gsang ba 'di ni sbyin/ /de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rang lus thabs ldan gyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ dam tshig tu bza' ba rnams kyi sbas don la spyod/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs pa yin no/ / de nas slob mas slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor la mchod par mos/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya brjod par yang 'dod de/ /'gal ba ni med do/ sher dbang gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ bdag ming rdo rje che ge mo/ /byang chub sems ni sgom byed pa/ /slob dpon zhabs kyi chu skyes la/ /dbang bskur don du gsol ba 'debs/ /slob dpon go 'phang che rang bzhin/ /skal pa chen po bdag la stsol/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi dbang bskur ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub pa/ /brtul zhugs mchog ni khyod drin gyis/ /bdag la nges par stsal nas kyang*/ /des ni sems can dpag med don/ /ji ltar 'dul bzhin bdag bgyid do/ / lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mig dar bcings/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba phaiṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba/ / zhes sogs bkra shis brjod/ oṃ mahā su kha badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣe ka s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti twe no ḍi ḍho me bha wa/

sid+dh+ya na ma ste bha ga bān badz+ra dha ra su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ badz+ra satwa oṃ āḥhūṃ/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ gzungs ma yid 'ongs 'di khyod kyis/ / bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /rdo rje rjes chags sbyor ba yi/ / bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro ba gsum 'di dag pa yin/ /de phyir 'di dang bral bar ni/ khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ / ces rig ma gtad/ dpa' bo byang chub sems bza' bar/ /khyod ni spro ba yin nam ci/ /rigs lnga las ni byung ba yi/ /rig ma mchod par rtag gus sam/ /bshang ba gci ba stob dang khrag /sogs bza' da lta yid ches sam/ /rjes su mthun smros dam tshig bzang*/ /ji ltar bde bar bu smros shig / ces dris pa la/ de la sogs pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /bud med rtag gus cis ma bgyid/ /bha ga nyid la tsum pa ni/ / zhes lan btab/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba thams cad pad+mar gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ / blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /mo k+ṣa ho/ bdag dang rig ma mi dmigs te/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'byung ba dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog la yum rdo rje phag mos yang dag par 'khyud pa'i sku can du gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas= zhes pa nas/ yab yum rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs par gyur/ rjes chags kyi mes bdun khri nyis stong gi rtsa'i tshogs pa byang chub kyi sems rnams bde ba chen po'i gnas spyi bor 'dus/

de las byang chub kyi sems mgrin par byon pa dga' ba/ snying gar byon pa mchog tu dga' ba/ lte bar byon pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ gsang bar byon pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba/ de rjes rdo rje nor bur lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rdzogs par gyur/ shes rab sbyor bas dpal ldan ni/ /'di nyid yang dag mtshon par bya/ /rdo rje skyil krung dag gi sems/ /nor bu'i nang du son lta bas/ /nor bu'i gnas de nyid du de kho na nyid mngon du byas te/ slar yang rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis/ lugs zlog gi dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas/ mas brtan pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong gnyis su med pa mngon du byas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mig dar phye/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ lam gzhan lus shes rab kyi rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang/ dam tshig tu/ las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya sgrub/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs pa'o/ / dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ / sogs sh+lo ka gnyis kyis gsol ba btab/ rtogs par bya ba bzhi pa ni/ zung 'jug lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dngos yin la/ de nyid gang gi rtogs pa'i shes pa de yang kho na nyid kyi mtshan nyid can no/ /ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ /rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rdul bral mthar ster zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /de ltar na don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag lam phyag rgya chen po gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o/ / da ni dbang gi mtha' rten rnams bshad de/ slob ma la dbang bzhi po ji tsam bskur ba/ de'i mthar 'di rnams byed pa yin mod kyang*/

dbang bzhi ka sdebs gcig la byed na/ skabs 'di'am bum dbang gi mthar byed pa gtso che ste/ gnyis po gang byas kyang 'dra'o/ /de yang 'di ltar/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /srid pa'i mtsho las mngon par rgal/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bur ni/ /sems can kun la bstan par bgyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sgra yi rjes su 'gro ba yi/ /shes rab mngon du rtogs gyur cig /gang gi 'jig rten thams cad du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /kun tu sgra bsnyan lta bu yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /skye med lhag par rtogs gyur cig /gang gi sangs rgyas gang kun dang*/ /'jig rten pa yi khams kun du/ /bla med bsam mi khyab pa'i dri/ /rang gi lus las spro bar bya/ /ro kun gcig gi rnam par ni/ /rang bzhin med pa'i gzugs kyi su/ /lhag pa ru ni rtogs gyur cig /gang gi sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ /srog chags gyur pa thams cad la/ /lha rdzas dpe med ro yi mchog /sprul nas su ni sbyin par byos/ /reg byas rjes su ma gos par/ khyod kyis lhag par rtogs gyur cig /gang gi reg bya'i khyad par rnams/ /rang gi sems las byung zhes pa/ /lhag par mos byas sna tshogs pa'i/ /bla med reg bya'i khyad par rnams/ /rang gi sems ni yongs gyur pa'i/ /lha rnams dag ni thams cad dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun dang yang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' sogs kun la/ /yang dag sbyor ba reg bya'i bde/ /nges par sbyar bar bya ba yin/ /lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /thur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bu khyod kyi/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hri ṭ+raṃ/ mig thur ro/ / a a/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / zhes pa nas/ 'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skye/ / me long ngo*/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ya ho/ oṃ nas/ rwa ga ya ma/ mda' gzhu'o/ /hūṃ rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /gsal zhing dwangs la rnyogs pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso/ /gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub sems ni 'di nyid yin par shes par gyis shig / me long gnyis pa'o/ / oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha ga raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe āḥ a thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /thams cad mchog gi mnyam nyid gsal/ /deng nas brtsams te dam bcas pa'i/ /sems ni bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun nas yongs su bkang nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ / chos bshad do/ / shes rab thabs kyi sems kyis ni/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /rtag tu dogs pa med byas nas/ /'dod pa lnga la longs spyod bya/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sems can don/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de lta de ltar sems can don/ /chags sogs dag pas sgrub par gyis/ /gang gzhan dam tshig la sdang ba/ /skye bo dam tshig nyams pa dag /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba yi/ / 'bad pa yis ni bsad par bya/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sbyor ba yis/ /pha rol nor ni phrogs gyur kyang*/ /sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags lta bu'i bde ba med/ /skye bo rnams la de rtag sbyin/ /sems can don du gzhan bud med/ /bsten pas bsod nams thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas la sogs smod pa la/ /rin chen 'byung ldan rnal 'byor gyis/ /tshig rtsub sbyor ba byas na ni/ /bla med dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /'od dpag med pa'i rdzun tshig smra/ /don yod grub pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /rgyud gsungs cho gas blo ldan kun/ /dam tshig dag pa brtan par

bya/ /chos rnams kun la ser sna dang*/ /sems can rnams la mi phan dag /nyams nga shin tu che na yang*/ /bu khyod kyis ni de mi bya/ /sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / de bzhin du/ rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ dkyil chog las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rgyal/ /kun gyi bdag po zhes bya ba'i/ /rdo rje 'khor lo khyod kyi bskor/ / zhes brjod par yang 'dod do/ /de ltar na rgyal ba rgyal zhes pa'i thad du/ rat+na dh+ri ga dang*/ a ro li ka dang*/ pra dz+nyā dh+ri ga dang*/ badz+ra dh+ri ga rnams 'don pa spo bar yang bya'o/ /'on kyang 'di ni sngags cig gi gung nas dum bur bsgyur bar mngon no/ /rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /de nas 'grub na rtsa sngags lan gsum/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum / bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje slob ma 'di nyid kyi rgyud la dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi gsung rig sngags kyi nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig / de ltar na sngags kyi rjes gnang ste/ de dag ni rjes gnang ngo*/ / dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas rdo rje dang pad+ma/ yum rdo rje snyem ma dkar mo/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa nas mnyam par sbyor ba dpral par oṃ= nas/ hūṃ/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad/

rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i rnam par phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ rang gi snying gar yang rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya/ tiṣ+ṭha e ka twā/ dha ra ya mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ / bdag nyid dpal he ru ka yab yum zhal phyag rgyan gos mtshon cha thams cad rdzogs par gyur/ hūṃ las byung ba'i cang te'u/ a las byung ba'i thod pa/ oṃ las byung ba'i tshangs pa'i skud pa rnams su gyur/ yab yum gyi snying po tshar bzhi/ he ru ka dpal phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u lhung bzed snod/ /byin pa dpa' bos bzung bar gyis/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ḍa ma ru/ /he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs pa/ /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor dag kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ / spyod pa'i brtul zhugs so/ /sngags kyi rjes gnang dang*/ brtul zhugs rnam pa gnyis po 'di/ /ming dbang dang*/ slob dpon gyi bar du byas kyang legs so/ / srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas/ /srid pa shin tu zhi ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ bdag gis khyod ni lung bstan no/ /kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje sarba ta thā ta ga sid+dh+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bhūr+bhu wa swa/ gang yang 'di ltar lung bstan pa de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston to/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bcug pa dang ni mthong bas kyang*/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/
