bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod yin te/ /mi thub tshugs pa yod min pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ khyod kyis rtag tu srung bar bya/ / sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ / rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ni/ /gang zhig skyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni spangs mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos ni mi spang zhing*/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /tshul chen bstan pa mi bya'o/ /rang gis bdag nyid yongs spangs nas/ /dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing*/ /ci bde bar ni bde ba bzung*/ /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ / nam yang yongs su dor mi bya/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mtshungs pas/ /slob dpon la ni gang smod pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun smad pas/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal thob 'gyur te/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug dang*/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtses pa dang*/ /bgegs dang log 'dren gtum po yis/ /bsad nas dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che/ /dge la rab tu mi spyoms pa/ / nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la ni gus bcas yon/ /rjes mthun khyod kyis dbul bar bya/ /des ni rims sogs gnod pa rnams/ /phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig srungs/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul/ / 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/

/de byin bsod nams tshogs yin te/ / tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /deng khyed skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ / gang phyir 'di la legs gnas pas/ /dam tshig lha rnams kun mnyam par/ / gnas par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pas/ /de ring tshe ldan de dbang bskur/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por gnas pa yin/ /der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing*/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /de ring khyod kyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob pa 'di la the tshom med/ /de ltar yid ni rab dwangs rdo rje nyid du kyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster bsten par gyis/ /de ring 'gro ba bde myur rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ /mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams bsten par 'gyur/ /de nas spyi bor gdugs bzung bskor ba byas par mos la/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ / slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /

zhes dang*/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ sngags bshad tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du bzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*/ khyod la rtag tu srung bar mdzad/ / ces slob dpon gyi gnas la dbugs phyung*/ dkyil 'khor kun gyis yongs su bskor ba yi/ /mnga' bdag sku mdog sngon po rgyal gyur cig /dmar bas ji ltar mdzes byas rgyal gyur cig /dam tshig gis brgyan mdzes pa rgyal gyur cig /zla phyed mgo bor brgyan pa rgyal gyur cig /lha mo'i 'khor gyis brgyan pa rgyal gyur cig /e ma ho/ dang po'i sangs rgyas don dam sku can rgyal/ /chos 'dod nor dang thar pa ster mdzad rgyal/ /ye shes lnga ldan dga' ldan rang bzhin rgyal/ /mgon po bde chen phyag na rdo rje rgyal/ / zhes me tog gtor/ gtso bos ji ltar= sogs gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te= sogs/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ / zhes sogs/ dam tshig gsum gyi glu bden stobs brjod pa dang bcas pa spyi dang mthun par brjod/ rjes chog ni/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ mchod yon nyer spyod rol mo rig ma bcu drug rnams sngags dang phyag rgya'i 'bul/ rtsa sngags gnyis sam/ snying po gnyis kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ rkang brgyad gnyis dang*/ rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pas bstod/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams/ bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes= nas/ byin gyis rlobs kyi= bar/ dngos grub blang*/ yig brgya bzlas/ ma 'byor= sogs dang*/ ma rnyed=

sogs/ bzod par gsol/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag= sogs dang*/ rten rnams la brtan bzhugs bya/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel byed na/ nyi ma snga ma rnams la/ rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor la yang brtan bzhugs bya/ nyi ma tha ma la rdul mtshon gshegs su gsol ba sogs spyi dang 'dra ste/ bde ba chen po'i char yang du blta'o/ /sgrub mchod zhag sbrel byed pa'i nyi ma phyi ma rnams la/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i dam tshig gi skabs/ 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi go 'phang la bkod slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka= zhes sbrel/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ yig las= zhes pa nas/ yo ga shud+dha 'i bar sta gon dang bsre ba de bor ba tsam gyis chog go /slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba ni/ dpal mkha' 'gro'i dbang chog gi tho yig go don dpyad pa dang bcas pa zhig bris zin par shes la cho ga ma 'dus pa rnams ni/ gsang ba spyi'i cho ga 'phreng ba sogs las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar bshad pa 'di ni tshad ldan gyi gzhung rnams kyi rgya las ma 'das pa yang yin la/ deng sang brgyud pa'i rim pa rgyal ba'i sde la 'ded par snang bas/ de'i gzhung gi legs pa'i cha rnams ma bor bar blangs pa'ang yin no// //'dir smras pa/ rmad byung rgyud kyi rgyal po bla med 'di'i/ /dbang bskur nye brgyud byin rlabs tshan ka can/ /gzhan la ma ltos rang la yod pa'i phyir/ /rgyal sde sogs la brten dgos nam yang med/ /'on kyang da lta'i 'gro kun rtog pas bcings/ /skur pa spong phyir rang brgyud tshol bar mdzad/ /skye bo rnams kyi blo ngor 'di tsam bsgrigs/ /zab don gzhan du 'chad 'gyur gsang ba che/ /'di tsam byas pa'i dge bas kyang*/ /'gro kun he ru ka thob shog /bdag 'dra 'khor bar gnas kyang bla/ /mig 'phrul lta bur gzhan don bya/ /zhes pa rgyud kyi rgyal po mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las byung ba'i/

/rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag 'jug 'khyer bde ba gsang ba'i snying po 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa twa ra nā tha'i blo gros kyi zer ma tsam mo/ /maṅgalaṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag 'jug gsang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 390--PAGE 389--PAGE 338-
